gloss: excuse me for going first; after you; go ahead

definitions.gloss: excuse me for going first; I'll go ahead
definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when leaving before others, such as leaving the office or a gathering earlier than colleagues. Short for お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します.

definitions.gloss: after you; go ahead; please go first
definitions.explanation: Used to politely yield to someone, inviting them to go before you — for example, letting someone enter an elevator or go through a door first.

notes:
A versatile polite expression with two main uses. In sense 1, it apologizes for leaving before others, commonly heard at the end of the workday. In sense 2, it politely invites someone else to go first.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します: excuse me for leaving first (full form, workplace standard)
- お{先|さき}に⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧: please go ahead (yielding to someone)
- お{先|さき}に{頂|いただ}きます: excuse me for going first (more humble)
- お{先|さき}に: short form, used casually among coworkers or family

USAGE:
Sense 1 is the more common workplace usage. When leaving the office before colleagues, saying お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します is standard etiquette. The typical response from colleagues is ⟦お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}→お疲れ様：05208_otsukaresama⟧でした (good work today).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します: the full polite form for leaving first
- ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧: please (go ahead) — less specific, more general invitation
- ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: I'll go ahead — casual/informal version
